problem: What is the domain in the $xy$-plane of the elliptic cylinder $\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{16}+\frac{(y+2)^{2}}{8}=1?$

choices.value: An ellipse centered at $(-1,2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $2$ and $2\sqrt{2}.$
An ellipse centered at $(1,-2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $4$ and $2\sqrt{2}.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(1,-2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $4$ and $2\sqrt{2}.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(1,2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $4$ and $2.$
An ellipse centered at $(1,-2)$ with semi-axes of lengths $2$ and $4.$
